name: 移動時間の上限を一つのつまみで指定する条件
prompt: Create a polished standalone redesign of the single compact travel-time filter shown in the references. The original Booking.com crop controls the layout; the Japanese preview controls exact labels and the app's green accent. Render only this one white interface component in an ultra-wide 3.15:1 crop, with no device frame and no surrounding page. Preserve the compact spacing and left alignment. Text must read exactly: bold heading 「所要時間」, label 「移動時間の上限（時間）」, and value 「27時間」. Use a clean Japanese sans-serif similar to Meiryo: heading bold about 20/28, label regular about 14/24, value regular about 14/24, dark text on white. Place a thin horizontal slider beneath the value, spanning nearly the full content width, with a solid deep green track and a circular green thumb at the far right to show the maximum. Match the simple hierarchy and proportions in the localized preview. Keep the component restrained and crisp; do not invent text, buttons, cards, icons, extra controls, borders, shadows, gradients, photos, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: Worker-reviewed image candidate. Source layout and Japanese labels were checked against the original crop and localized mock. No owner approval or implementation claim.
